snippet.title: Crystal Palace vs Manchester City Who Wins? #PremierLeague
snippet.description:
Who comes out on top? 

The last time these two met in a final, Glasner's Eagles SHOCKED Pep's machine — Eberechi Eze fired Palace to a 1-0 win in the 2025 FA Cup Final, with Dean Henderson saving a penalty to seal the club's FIRST EVER major trophy. Giant-killers at Wembley. 

Now it's Selhurst Park under the lights. Can Mateta, Wharton and Sarr do it AGAIN against Haaland, Foden and the Citizens? Or does Pep get his revenge?

snippet.title: Barcelona vs Athletic Club | ¿Quién gana? / Who Wins? | LaLiga
snippet.description:
🔵🔴 Edin Terzić's first visit to Camp Nou as Athletic Bilbao's head coach – the German who led Borussia Dortmund to the 2024 Champions League final, now facing Hans-Dieter Flick's side.

⚽ Lamine Yamal, Raphinha, Pedri & Fermín López take on the Williams brothers, Nico & Iñaki, plus Unai Simón and Beñat Sancet.

📊 Barça have won their last 6 meetings vs Athletic in a row and thrashed Elche 5-0 last matchday, while the Basques opened the season with a defeat to Sevilla.
